metadata.case_name: WONG MING KWAN v. WING MING ELECTRICAL CO. LTD. AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: lorry driver cum delivery worker employed by the 1st defendant since 1995
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: should be able to work as a driver or as a light delivery worker

injuries.description: Right leg lacerations with complete cut of right anterior tibial artery, deep peroneal nerve, anterior tibial tendon, extensor hallux longus tendon and extensor digitorum longus tendon.
source: The diagnosis was right leg lacerations with complete cut of right anterior tibial artery, deep peroneal nerve, anterior tibial tendon, extensor hallux longus tendon and extensor digitorum longus tendon. There was also about 40% cut of the right patella tendon.

injuries.description: About 40% cut of the right patella tendon.
source: There was also about 40% cut of the right patella tendon.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of muscle, fascia or tendon of anterior muscle group at lower leg level

manifestations.description: numbness over the right lower limb
limited range of movement in the right knee and ankle
had to walk with elbow crutches (post-operatively) and later walked with a cane outdoors
partial numbness along the surgical scars; poor sensation over the right foot dorsum and sole
marked stiffness in the right big toe
frequent night pain in the lower leg scars
decreased endurance with prolonged walking, standing, and repetitive lifting of heavy objects

treatments_received: Emergency operation (arterial anastomosis, nerve and tendon repair)
Use of elbow crutches and later cane
Transfer to Kowloon Hospital for convalescence
Occupational therapy (pressure stocking for right knee scars)

losses.description: Residual pain in his right leg, stiffness and numbness, limited movement and weakness of the right lower limb leading to decreased endurance and need for walking aid (cane/elbow crutches).
